import cv2
import numpy as np

# Load card_2 and card_4
card_2 = cv2.imread('/workdir/data/cards/card_2.png')
card_4 = cv2.imread('/workdir/data/cards/card_4.png')

# Check the pixel values in the center region to understand the suit
h2, w2 = card_2.shape[:2]
h4, w4 = card_4.shape[:2]

# Get center region
center2 = card_2[h2//2-50:h2//2+50, w2//2-50:w2//2+50]
center4 = card_4[h4//2-50:h4//2+50, w4//2-50:w4//2+50]

# Convert to HSV
center2_hsv = cv2.cvtColor(center2, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
center4_hsv = cv2.cvtColor(center4, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)

red_mask2 = ((center2_hsv[:,:,0] < 10) | (center2_hsv[:,:,0] > 170)) & (center2_hsv[:,:,1] > 50) & (center2_hsv[:,:,2] > 50)
red_mask4 = ((center4_hsv[:,:,0] < 10) | (center4_hsv[:,:,0] > 170)) & (center4_hsv[:,:,1] > 50) & (center4_hsv[:,:,2] > 50)

red_pixels2 = cv2.countNonZero(red_mask2)
red_pixels4 = cv2.countNonZero(red_mask4)

total_pixels2 = red_mask2.size
total_pixels4 = red_mask4.size

print(f'card_2: {red_pixels2}/{total_pixels2} red pixels = {100*red_pixels2/total_pixels2:.1f}%')
